decision_rule: If nonlinear log-regret training fit becomes strong but LOCO generalization remains poor, the remaining bottleneck is terrain representation / context-to-response generalization. If training fit remains poor, do not change terrain encoding yet.
interpretation_guard: TRAIN rough-context LOCO only. No validation/test/hard terrain is used. Frozen T5.5d labels, physical atlas, and scalarization are unchanged.

model.input: [fold-local PCA terrain latent, friction mu, beta simplex lambda]

selector: Predict all 21 original-space regret vectors, construct the predicted Pareto front, and minimize the original augmented weighted Tchebycheff score for w.
supervision: 19 TRAIN contexts x 21 beta points = 399 dense regret-surface samples per fold
target: standardized log1p(frozen T5.5d context-local normalized regret)
target_transform_guard: log1p is used only to condition the regression loss. Predictions are inverse-transformed back to the original frozen regret space before Pareto filtering, mission scalarization, and beta selection.
terrain_encoder: strict fold-local PCA k95 from 17 rough TRAIN patches
